notes: SITRToken mints its entire fixed supply once to the deploying launch factory. Its sole constructor argument is the launch number; the factory is msg.sender and the Ethereum Uniswap v4 PoolManager is a constant. There is no owner, admin function or subsequent minting. The factory handles the swarm allocation and pool seed. The token resolves the launch's Merkle distributor through factory.distributorOf(uint64) and permanently pins the first valid nonzero result during a transfer or claim. Only ERC-20 transfers from the PoolManager to another address incur the 3% fee, deducted from the receiver's amount; transfers to the PoolManager and wallet-to-wallet transfers are untaxed. Fees stay in the token contract and accrue pro rata to eligible balances before the buyer's net tokens are credited, so a returning buyer earns only on its pre-buy balance. The PoolManager, token contract, burn address and launch distributor are excluded from dividends. claim() pays the caller; anyone may call claimFor(address) to pay that holder directly. Fees collected with no eligible balance remain unallocated, and there is no privileged withdrawal. ERC-6909 balances inside the PoolManager are outside this token's scope. The opening pool price is derived from the specified economics and deployed currency order; initialPrice is provenance only.
